description: What share of total foreign Treasury holdings was reported for foreign official institutions over a fixed monthly window? Joins the MFH Foreign Official memo line to Grand Total, returning bounded/paginated USD-million values and a two-decimal share for each month, plus run id, exact official source hashes, vintage, and methodology caveats. This is a custodial aggregate, not a country allocation or investment signal.

end_month.description: Exact calendar month in YYYY-MM format.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

start_month.description: Exact calendar month in YYYY-MM format.

name: treasury_tic_official_share
